original.text: bhaja govindaṃ bhaja govindaṃ govindaṃ bhaja mūḍhamate / samprāpte sannihite kāle nahi nahi rakṣati ḍukṛñ karaṇe
original.edition: vulgate wording recalled from memory (verify against an edition)

paraphrase: Worship Govinda, worship Govinda, worship Govinda, you fool; when the appointed time (of death) comes, (the grammar rule) 'ḍukṛñ karaṇe' will not save you.
notes: Attributed to Śaṅkara (attribution traditional or disputed).

original.text: satsaṅgatve nissaṅgatvaṃ nissaṅgatve nirmohatvam / nirmohatve niścalatattvaṃ niścalatattve jīvanmuktiḥ
original.edition: vulgate wording recalled from memory (verify against an edition)

paraphrase: From good company comes non-attachment; from non-attachment, freedom from delusion; from freedom from delusion, steadiness in truth; from steadiness in truth, liberation while living.
notes: Verse number varies. Attributed to Śaṅkara (attribution traditional).
